facts.fact: By Friday afternoon, Beau had reread Carson’s last text enough times to qualify as embarrassing—not because it said anything interesting, but because it was exciting.
facts.anchor: By Friday afternoon, I had reread Carson’s last text enough times to qualify as embarrassing.

facts.fact: Carson warned Beau that if he shows up before seven, Meme will invite him inside and he will never escape.

facts.fact: One part of Carson’s truck was delayed until Monday, and Carson had asked Beau about it exactly twice while acting as if she wasn’t disappointed.
